searchText: Yes we already are week of labor day will be public. Next week team is meeting in some Swiss canton for ski trip, then is labor day weekend. I wont be going though i did t get invited In the response for `eth_getBlockByNumber`, will the field for `miner` be empty after the merge? No, it will be set to the feeRecipient, the address which collects all transaction fees Here something for you to read: CL: https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec https://eth2book.info https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/tree/dev/specs - pure spec The Merge: Rationales for the two EIPs are useful to read (and the spec part of course) https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-3675 https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4399 Someone has do to the work What's up on Goerli? <@552133098075193354> also put this together: https://github.com/timbeiko/eth-roadmap-faq About 4 months old but still a lot of relevant information there for you. unsure, looking into it now just seen couple of epochs below 60% on https://goerli.beaconcha.in/ , now is back on finalizing hehehe Based on bordel.wtf the hash rate would need to spike to 1600TH/s for someone to try to race the bellatrix fork like they did on ropsten, which basically means adding almost another 800TH/s hashrate. By my estimate that means millions of GPUs, and correct me if I'm wrong but there's still no real economic incentive to do that other than trolling, right? I can tell you now that isn't happening That being said I can see 50-100 rejoining if inno fixes its asic a10's that bugged on the 5gb dag since many of them have 6-7 gb. Not gonna happen. Max Nethash recorded was a spike at 1100 Th/s with eth around 3000$ around the beginning of May. Since then, many retails with high power costs and old gen cards & Asics stopped mining. If someone has the space and capacity to add 800 Th/s to the network (500 MW with the most efficient ASIC), they would have attempt a 51% attack instead of ruining the party for no reason since a TTD override could be implemented if this scenario will appear. hah ya really good point about the 51% attack, trolling the TTD would be the least of our worries. 😊 yeah, I would like to ask Mario if the Difficoulty bomb has been taken into consideration in the estimation of the TTD, since atm we are around 13.6s/block and I think we might move to the next period (13.9s ???) in the next day or 2. https://ycharts.com/indicators/ethereum_average_block_time#:~:text=Basic%20Info,4.69%25%20from%20one%20year%20ago.
